description: The Montague Boston Custom is a full-size, folding frameset with track dropouts. This frame takes 700c-wheels for ideal riding in the city. It can support a flip-flop hub so the rear wheel can operate as either a fixed-gear or free-wheel setup. The Boston is a fast bike for the urban rider who wants simplicity with excellent performance. The Clix quick release and the patented folding system convert the folding bike from full-size to trunk-size in less than 20 seconds.
